prompt.zh-TW: 日暮文具社用現金 {{money:e1.amount}} 進了一批鋼筆，這個月還沒賣出任何一支。這筆進貨之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Sunset Stationery pays {{money:e1.amount}} in cash for a batch of fountain pens and has not sold any of them this month. After this purchase, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_p7h3c5xq}}這一列增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，但一支都沒賣出，{{term:tm_q4k9v2nd}}那一列也同時增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，兩者相抵，{{term:tm_g5c2m8tw}}的小計沒有變，{{term:tm_g8p4w1rz}}也不變。資產負債表上的存貨增加了同樣的金額。進貨不是費用，賣出去的那一刻才變成成本。
explanation.en: The {{term:tm_p7h3c5xq}} line rises by {{money:e1.amount}}, but since none were sold, the {{term:tm_q4k9v2nd}} line rises by {{money:e1.amount}} too; the two cancel out, so the {{term:tm_g5c2m8tw}} subtotal and {{term:tm_g8p4w1rz}} do not change. Inventory on the balance sheet rises by the same amount. A purchase is not an expense; it becomes a cost only when the goods are sold.

hint.zh-TW: 賣出之前，鋼筆是費用還是資產？
hint.en: Before they are sold, are the pens an expense or an asset?
